description: Create a predefined room (it exists before anyone joins). Name: A-Z 0-9 _ - (stored uppercase); LOBBY is reserved. `permanent: true` keeps it (and its data) when it empties. `ttlInactivity` gives it its own inactivity time (days, 0 = never deleted); without it the app's value for public rooms applies.

moderators.description: Per-app user ids that moderate this room

ttlInactivity.description: Days without activity before Neblla deletes this room (0 = never). Overrides the app's per-type value (rooms.public/private.ttlInactivity: 30 / 90 by default) for this room only.

name: neblla_create_room
title: Create room
